name: textarea
title: Textarea
summary: Multi-line text input. Adopts the v0.6 field-shell contract — paints its own border, bg, focus halo standalone; renders bare inside <Field>. Auto-grows via `field-sizing: content`; cap via min-height / max-height in consumer style.
description: Token-driven multi-line text input with auto-grow via field-sizing.
skillDescription: Use when generating a multi-line text input — long notes, descriptions, comments, AI prompt input. Auto-grows with content; honors the v0.6 field-shell visual contract. For AI prompts specifically, prefer @lumen/ai-prompt-input.
useWhen: Multi-line entry — comments, descriptions, special instructions.
Inside <Field> shell with a <Label> and optional <ValidationMessage>.
Long-form input where height should grow with content.
anatomy: Min-height 22 (5.5rem) by default; consumer can override via style.height or className
Focus + error halos identical to Input
api: `field-sizing: content` is default — height grows with content.
never: NEVER pair with type=password (textarea has no type attribute).
a11yRules: Pair with <Label htmlFor> in <Field>, or supply aria-label / aria-labelledby.
Use aria-describedby when paired with a ValidationMessage.
do: Pair with <Field> for the label + validation chain.
Let it auto-grow; do not force fixed height unless necessary.
dont: Don't use for single-line input — use <Input>.
Don't disable field-sizing without strong reason.
